settings.pageSubtitle: Storage paths, playback and metadata options; scans are manual only (full or per path).
settings.storageCardDesc: Multiple library roots. After checking paths, Refresh metadata re-scrapes indexed items only (no disk walk); Rescan walks disk for new files.
settings.storageStatusActionBlocked: This storage path is not available. Check the disk before scanning or importing.
settings.defaultImportPathDesc: Imported movies are copied into this library path. The Add movies entry uses this target for future imports.
settings.defaultImportPathSaveError: Could not save the default import folder. Try again later.
settings.libraryPathsHint: Only absolute paths are supported. Examples:
settings.addPathDialogDesc: Enter an absolute video root; you can pick a folder (in the browser you may still need to copy the path). Examples:
settings.notAbsolute: Not an absolute path. Start from a drive letter (Windows) or / (Unix).
settings.pickFolderHintSaveSuffix: After you paste a valid absolute path, Save becomes available.
settings.savePathDisabledTitle: Enter a valid absolute path (drive or leading /) before saving
settings.metadataSectionHint: Select one or more roots below; only queued scrape for indexed items, no disk walk. For new files use Rescan first.
settings.editTitleHint: Leave empty and save to use the folder name as title.
settings.removePathConfirmDesc: This removes “{title}” from your configuration. Files on disk are not deleted.
settings.removePathFailed: Failed to remove the library root. Try again later.
settings.organizeDesc: Provides automated management for your library.
settings.organizeHint: When new videos are detected, Curated automatically organizes each title and its related files into that title's folder.
settings.metadataMovieProviderHelpP1: “Scrape” means fetching artwork, synopsis, cast, and tags from provider sites and saving them into your library.
settings.metadataMovieProviderHelpP2: Preferences on this page are written to library-config.cfg under the app config directory; some changes apply fully after restarting the Curated backend.
settings.metadataMovieProviderModeTooltip: Auto: query every registered movie provider in parallel and take the best weighted match. Specified: only the site you pick. Chain: try providers in list order and fall back when one fails. Settings persist and the backend runs the scrape.
settings.metadataMovieProviderAutoHint: Same as default: search every movie provider concurrently and take the top-ranked result.
settings.metadataMovieProviderSpecifiedHint: Search only the selected site; switch back to auto or change source if there is no hit.
settings.metadataMovieProviderChainHint: Try providers in order; if one fails, fall back to the next. Useful for stable sources first.
settings.metadataMovieProviderChainHelp: Drag a row or the grip to reorder; the waveform button pings one source. Rows show a spinner while “Ping all” runs. Reorder, add, or remove sources to save automatically.
settings.metadataMovieProviderChainEmpty: No providers in chain. Add from the list below.
settings.metadataMovieProviderChainNoList: The server did not return a provider list, so you cannot add new sources to the chain. If a chain is already saved, you can still view, reorder, remove, or save. Ensure the Curated backend is running and the Metatube engine exposes movie providers.
settings.metadataMovieProviderNoList: No provider list is available (mock mode or engine not listing sources). Only auto mode can be used.
settings.providerHealthHint: The Curated backend probes each registered Metatube movie provider with a lightweight request (similar network conditions to scraping).
settings.providerHealthMockHint: Web API is off or mock mode is on; provider probes require VITE_USE_WEB_API=true and the Curated backend running.
settings.lanAccessRestartHint: Fully quit Curated and reopen it to change the listener. Closing the window is not enough.
settings.lanAccessMockHint: Mock mode cannot expose the real HTTP server to the LAN.
settings.proxyDesc: Used only when Curated fetches metadata and artwork. It does not change your system or browser proxy. Saving updates your library settings.
settings.proxyEnabledHint: When off, direct connection; when on, choose the scheme and fill in IP address and port.
settings.proxyUrlPlaceholder: Local HTTP proxy (e.g. Clash): http://127.0.0.1:7890 — not https:// (causes proxyconnect EOF).
settings.proxyUrlRequired: Proxy URL is required when proxy is enabled.
settings.proxyHostRequired: IP address is required when proxy is enabled.
settings.proxyPortRequired: Port is required when proxy is enabled.
settings.proxyPortInvalid: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
settings.proxyMockHint: Mock / Web API off: proxy is kept in page memory only. Use VITE_USE_WEB_API=true with the Curated backend to persist server-side.
settings.experimentalDesc: Early capabilities live here behind switches, all off by default; turning them off hides their UI completely without affecting anything else. They graduate into regular settings once stable.
settings.experimentalAgentHint: Shows the top-bar Agent entry and opens a floating chat window (draggable, remembers position); off hides everything.
settings.experimentalProviderDesc: Library content is sensitive; a local model is recommended (e.g. Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1). Review privacy and content policies before using a cloud service.
settings.experimentalMockHint: Mock mode: settings stay in this browser (localStorage) and the test is simulated.
settings.proxySaveToastMock: Proxy settings were saved for the current page session.
settings.proxySaveToastDisabled: Proxy settings saved. Direct connection is now active.
settings.proxySaveToastVerified: Proxy settings saved. Connectivity check passed: {ms} ms, HTTP {status}.
settings.proxySaveToastUnverified: Proxy settings saved, but the proxy check failed: {message}
settings.proxyConnectivityTestHint: The two buttons below run quick checks through the proxy settings above—no need to save first. One targets metadata source reachability; the other checks broader international access.
settings.curatedCardDescShort: Every capture is saved to the in-app Curated Frames library. The option below only controls extra file output.
settings.curatedStorageTechTooltip: With the backend API on, data persists in the server-side local library; with API off, the browser stores frames locally. Works together with the save mode below.
settings.curatedAppHint: Save to the app library only; do not trigger an extra download or folder write.
settings.curatedDownloadHint: Save to the app library and also download a PNG via the browser each time (code and time in the filename).
settings.curatedDirHint: Save to the app library and also write each capture into a folder you choose in Chrome / Edge and similar browsers. If the system revokes access, use Re-authorize below to pick the folder again.
settings.curatedDirUnsupported: This browser cannot pick a folder; use Chrome / Edge or Save and auto-download.
settings.curatedShortcutBody: Set a single-key shortcut for capturing the current frame in the player. Reserved playback keys cannot be reused: {keys}.
settings.curatedShortcutReserved: These keys are already assigned to player shortcuts and cannot be used here.
settings.curatedShortcutInvalid: Use a single letter, number, function key, Page Up, or Page Down.
settings.exportNone: No folder chosen; disk write may fail without permission.
settings.curatedReauthorizeHelp: If saves fail or permission was revoked, pick the folder again to restore access.
settings.curatedCorsNote: Videos from other origins without cross-origin permission may not capture. Same-origin or streams proxied through this app usually work.
settings.curatedCorsLearnAria: Open MDN in a new tab
settings.playbackCardDesc: Configure browser playback, HLS stream push, and native-player defaults. In development or test builds, extra debugging switches appear here as well.
settings.hardwareDecodeHint: Controls HLS playback hardware acceleration. When enabled, Curated tries hardware video transcode first and falls back to software when needed.
settings.playbackHardwareEncoderHint: Auto mode keeps the current adaptive behavior and remembers the last working encoder. You can also pin a preference such as AMF on AMD hardware.
settings.playbackStreamPushEnabledHint: Allows the backend to create an HLS session with ffmpeg when the browser should not play the source file directly.
settings.playbackForceStreamPushHint: Shown only in development or test environments. When enabled, playback prefers the FFmpeg HLS path even for files the browser could usually play directly, making it easier to verify stream-push and hardware-acceleration behavior.
settings.playbackFfmpegCommandHint: Executable name or absolute path used for HLS stream push. In most cases, leaving this as ffmpeg is recommended.
settings.playbackNativePlayerEnabledHint: When enabled, the player page asks the browser to open the current movie in a local player instead of letting the backend execute a program directly.
settings.playbackNativePlayerPresetHint: Controls which browser protocol Curated prefers for local-player handoff. The PotPlayer preset uses a browser-side protocol link so it does not depend on backend process launching.
settings.playbackNativePlayerCommandHint: When you hand off playback to an external player, the browser builds the launch URL from this template using protocols registered on your device—Curated does not start player executables from the backend. Use the preset or placeholder as a guide for URL, file path, and resume time. Advanced users can still customize the pattern.
settings.playbackPreferNativePlayerHint: A preference flag reserved for future playback routing. When enabled, Curated remembers that you usually want a local player before the in-page player.
settings.playbackSeekBackwardStepHint: Used by the player back button, Left Arrow, and J shortcut.
settings.playbackSeekForwardStepHint: Used by the player forward button, Right Arrow, and L shortcut.
settings.playbackSeekBackwardInvalid: Backward seek step must be an integer greater than 0.
settings.playbackSeekForwardInvalid: Forward seek step must be an integer greater than 0.
settings.playbackSyncing: Syncing playback settings to the backend…
settings.autoScrapeHint: When on, watch library roots for new files, debounce, then auto-scan and queue scrapes. Off ignores watch-driven work (manual or scheduled full scans unchanged).
settings.autoActorProfileScrapeHint: When enabled, Curated automatically queues profile scrapes for actors that still have neither avatar nor summary. Successful movie scrapes enqueue those actors immediately, and a background sweep backfills existing library actors in small batches. Lazy actor-page scraping stays available.
settings.backupCardDesc: Create a consistent database package, verify checksums and SQLite integrity, or assess a package before an offline restore.
settings.backupDirectoryHint: Enter an absolute directory on the machine running the Curated backend. Creation generates a UTC-timestamped .curated-backup filename and never overwrites an existing file.
settings.backupDirectoryAbsolute: Enter an absolute Windows, UNC, or Unix directory path.
settings.backupDirectorySaveFailed: The backup was created, but its directory preference could not be saved: {error}
settings.backupPathHint: Enter the absolute path to a specific .curated-backup file for verification or restore preflight. A newly created path appears here automatically.
settings.backupPathAbsolute: Enter an absolute Windows, UNC, or Unix backup package path.
settings.backupPickerUnsupported: This browser cannot reveal an absolute server path. Enter the path manually or use the Electron desktop app.
settings.backupCreatedVerificationFailed: The package was created but did not pass immediate verification. Do not use it for restore.
settings.backupOfflineRestoreHint: Curated never replaces the live database from this page. After a successful preflight, fully quit the app and use the documented backup-restore maintenance command with explicit confirmation. The previous database and config are retained as rollback files.
settings.libraryHealthDescription: Run a read-only integrity pass across SQLite, storage roots, source files, cached assets, metadata failures, and import staging.
settings.libraryHealthScanHint: Offline or mismatched drives are reported once and skipped during file checks, so disconnected storage is never mistaken for deleted media.
settings.libraryHealthWebRequired: Library health requires Web API mode and the Curated backend. Mock mode never inspects local files or SQLite.
settings.libraryHealthHealthyHint: SQLite integrity, available storage, indexed source files, and registered assets passed this scan.
settings.libraryHealthIdleHint: Start a scan to create a point-in-time report. Detection is separate from repair and does not delete or overwrite files.
settings.libraryHealthFindingsHint: Each item has a stable category and affected entity or path. Export the full report before manual maintenance when useful.
settings.libraryHealthFindingsLimited: Additional findings are summarized above or omitted by the response limit ({count} not shown in this list).
settings.libraryHealthMetadataRepairHint: Retry only titles currently classified as missing or failed. Each child scrape remains task-tracked and the batch is capped at 25 items per confirmation.
settings.libraryHealthRepairConfirmWarning: A successful scrape updates metadata for the selected titles. Existing healthy titles outside this finding category are not included.
settings.libraryHealthCleanupHint: Only exact findings from the current scan are eligible. Curated rechecks scope before deleting and records an audit for every cleanup.
settings.libraryHealthCleanupConfirmDescription: Clean up to {count} current findings classified as {action}.
settings.libraryHealthCleanupConfirmWarning: This action deletes only revalidated orphan rows or strictly scoped unregistered staging directories. It cannot be undone; final movie files are never eligible.
settings.libraryHealthCleanupFinishedWithErrorsTo: Cleanup finished with skipped or failed items
settings.manualCardDesc: Hooks for scan and metadata workflows.
settings.triggerScrapeHint: Queue a metadata refresh for indexed titles under every configured library root (same pipeline as batch refresh in Video storage).
settings.triggerScrapeNoPaths: Add at least one library folder under Video storage first.
settings.triggerScrapeMockHint: Mock mode cannot queue backend scrapes. Enable the Web API and connect the Curated backend.
settings.triggerFullScanHint: Re-index all configured folders and pick up new files.
settings.rebuildCacheHint: Regenerate poster derivatives and clear stale previews.
settings.configCardDesc: This page mirrors the document structure while staying front-end only.
settings.configCardBody: Future desktop integration can bind these controls to typed contracts without rewriting the shell.
settings.aboutVersionMock: Mock mode (Web API off) — no backend version
settings.aboutIntro: Curated is a local-first media library delivered through an Electron desktop shell around a Vue UI and Go backend. Data and metadata live in SQLite; browser access and Mock mode share the same service contracts, while deeper native-player integration remains optional future work.
settings.aboutDataModeWebApi: Web API enabled (VITE_USE_WEB_API): requests go to the Curated backend via /api; favorites, playback progress, curated frames, and more persist in the server database.
settings.aboutDataModeMock: Demo mode (Web API off): in-browser mock data; some features differ or are unavailable vs. a real backend.
settings.aboutDevProxyHint: In dev, Vite usually proxies /api to http://localhost:8080; run the Curated backend alongside for a real library.
settings.aboutHomepageRefreshBody: Dev-only: force-regenerate today's UTC homepage snapshot so you can verify the latest recommendation constraints immediately.
settings.aboutHomepageRefreshFailed: Could not refresh today's homepage snapshot.
settings.appUpdateIdleBody: Curated will check the latest GitHub release when needed.
settings.appUpdateCheckingBody: Comparing your installer version with the latest GitHub release.
settings.appUpdateAvailableBody: A new installer is ready. Download the latest setup package directly, or open the release page if the installer link is unavailable.
settings.appUpdateErrorBody: Curated could not confirm the latest release right now.
settings.appUpdateUnsupportedBody: The current runtime does not expose an installer version, so Curated cannot compare releases reliably.
settings.appUpdateToastCurrent: You're already on the latest version.
settings.watchTimeDesc: Effective watch-time statistics over the past 3 months.
settings.watchTimeEmpty: No watch-time records yet. Start playback and Curated will update these stats automatically.
settings.connectedClientsDesc: Devices and browsers that have accessed Curated during this backend session.
settings.connectedClientsPrivacy: MAC addresses are not collected or shown.
settings.securityDesc: Require a local PIN before other browsers or devices can use this Curated server.
settings.securitySetupHint: Set a 4-8 digit PIN. Curated stores only a salted hash, not the original PIN.
settings.securityEnabledHint: PIN lock is enabled for this backend. Unlock each browser once, or mark a trusted device on the lock screen.
settings.securityDisablePinHint: After this, using this Curated server will no longer require a PIN. You can enable it again at any time.
settings.securityLockNowHint: End this browser session immediately. Trusted-forever devices can still stay unlocked until explicitly locked.
settings.securitySessionHint: Regular devices ask for the PIN again after this much inactivity. Activity extends the session; trusted devices can skip future prompts.
settings.securityLockOnRestartHint: When the backend restarts, non-trusted devices must unlock again. Trusted-forever devices remain trusted.
settings.securityTrustedSessionsHint: Sessions created with Trust this device forever appear here. Review recent activity and revoke another device at any time.
settings.securityTrustedSessionsConfirmOne: This device will need the PIN again. Revoke its permanent trust?
settings.securityTrustedSessionsConfirmOthers: Every trusted device except the current session will need the PIN again. Continue?
settings.securityLanPolicyHint: MVP recovery is local-only: stop the backend and reset the PIN from the server database or a future recovery tool.

settings.backendLogMockHint: Demo mode has no backend process; enable Web API to persist server-side log settings.
settings.errPickUnsupported: Cannot open a folder picker here; paste an absolute path. A desktop client could use a native dialog.

settings.errScanConflict: A scan is already running. Wait for it to finish.
settings.errScanStart: Failed to start scan. Try again later.
settings.errMetadataSelect: Select one or more storage directories.
settings.errMetadataBatch: Batch refresh failed. Ensure the backend is running.
settings.metadataQueued: Queued metadata rescrape for {n} titles (background, same as detail refresh).
settings.metadataInvalid: Paths not matched to configured roots: {paths}
settings.curatedExportNoApi: Folder export is not supported in this browser; use Chrome/Edge or Save and auto-download.
settings.curatedExportDenied: Folder permission denied. Try again and allow access.
settings.curatedExportFail: Failed to pick folder. Try again later.
settings.curatedExportClearFail: Failed to clear saved export folder.
settings.appearanceHint: Light, dark, or match the system; saved locally and applies immediately.
settings.languageHint: Applies immediately; your choice is remembered after refresh.
settings.curatedExportFormatHint: Single export from the detail dialog, right-click export, and batch export all use the format selected here.
settings.gamepadControlsHint: Use a standard Gamepad API controller, including DualSense, to control playback. This browser-local preference is saved on this device.
settings.securityLanRequiresPinHint: Keep enabled when phones, tablets, or another computer can reach this backend over your network.
settings.securityTrustDeviceHint: On the lock screen, choose Trust this device forever after entering the PIN. Curated then keeps a long-lived HTTP-only session for that browser.
settings.autoDownloadUpdatesDesc: Choose whether Curated prepares new installer packages in the background after it finds an update.
settings.autoDownloadUpdatesHint: When enabled, the startup background update check downloads and SHA256-verifies a newer installer. Installing it still requires your confirmation.
settings.launchAtLoginDesc: Start Curated in the Windows tray after you sign in. Autostart launches silently and does not open the browser page.
settings.launchAtLoginHint: When enabled, Windows starts the tray app and local server in the background. You can still open the full UI from the tray or by launching Curated manually.
settings.launchAtLoginUnsupportedHint: This runtime cannot safely register Windows login startup. Use a built Curated executable instead of a temporary dev process.
settings.launchAtLoginMockHint: Demo mode has no backend process, so login startup cannot be configured here.
settings.backendLogDesc: These options are saved with your settings. Restart Curated for changes to fully apply to log files on disk. Leave the folder blank to use the default log location on this computer.
settings.clientLogDesc: Choose how detailed diagnostic messages are in this browser. Changes apply immediately.
settings.comicLibraryDesc: Optional zip/cbz comic library settings. Comics stay separate from the video library.
settings.comicLibraryEnabledDesc: The app entry is visible. Disabling only hides comic entry points; it does not delete source archives, index data, progress, or cache.
settings.comicLibraryDisabledDesc: Enable the beta to configure library paths, reading preferences, and cache.
settings.comicAutoWatchDesc: Watch comic storage paths for new or changed zip/cbz files and add them to the comic library. Video paths are not scanned.
settings.comicLibraryPathRequired: Add a comic storage path before enabling comics.
settings.comicLibraryPathAbsoluteRequired: Use an absolute comic storage path, such as D:\\Comics or /Users/you/Comics.
settings.comicLibraryPathsDesc: Only zip/cbz archives under these paths are scanned. Source archives are never extracted into the library.
settings.comicLibraryPathDialogDesc: Enter an absolute comic root; you can pick a folder from the system directory picker. Examples:
settings.comicDefaultImportPathDesc: Used later by comic import. It is independent from the video import path.
settings.comicReaderDesc: Default reading behavior for new comics. Each comic can still keep its own reading preferences later.
settings.comicCacheDesc: Separate thumbnail/page cache for comics. Cleanup removes cached derivatives only, never source zip/cbz files.
settings.comicCacheLimitDesc: Applies only to comic cache files.
settings.comicCacheUsageUnknown: Cache status has not been loaded yet.
settings.photoLibraryDesc: Optional zip/cbz photo book library settings. Photo books stay separate from videos and comics.
settings.photoLibraryEnabledDesc: The app entry is visible. Disabling only hides photo entry points; it does not delete source archives, index data, or cache.
settings.photoLibraryDisabledDesc: Enable the beta to configure library paths, reading preferences, and cache.
settings.photoAutoWatchDesc: Watch photo storage paths for new or changed zip/cbz files and add them to the photo library. Video and comic paths are not scanned.
settings.photoViewerDesc: Default photo viewer mode, fit, and direction.
settings.photoCacheDesc: This Beta uses original images as thumbnails; a separate photo cache is not active yet.
settings.photoCacheLimitDesc: The reserved limit is saved but does not currently enforce a photo cache budget.
settings.photoLibraryPathRequired: Add a photo storage path before enabling photos.
settings.photoLibraryPathAbsoluteRequired: Use an absolute photo storage path, such as D:\\Photos or /Users/you/Photos.
settings.photoLibraryPathsDesc: Only zip/cbz photo books under these paths are scanned. Video and comic paths are never scanned.
settings.photoLibraryPathDialogDesc: Enter an absolute photo root; you can pick a folder from the system directory picker. Examples:
settings.photoDefaultImportPathDesc: New photo imports use this path, independently of movies and comics.

detailPage.previewHelp: Sample images from metadata scrape; click a thumb to open the viewer (arrow keys). Hotlink blocking may hide images until a proxy exists.
detailPage.previewEmpty: No preview image URLs (text-only scrape or provider omitted art).
detailPage.commentReadonlyTrashHint: This title is in trash: read-only. Restore it to edit and save notes again.
detailPage.commentAiUnconfigured: No AI provider configured. Open Settings → Experimental.
detailPage.commentAiPreviewDesc: The original note is kept until you apply.

detailPanel.editMovieDesc: Change title, studio, summary, release date, and runtime. Leave a field empty and save to revert that field to the scraped value. Code and file path cannot be changed here.
detailPanel.movieEditInvalidRelease: Use YYYY-MM-DD for release date, or leave empty to use scraped value.
detailPanel.movieEditInvalidRuntime: Runtime must be an integer from 0 to 99999, or leave empty to use scraped value.
detailPanel.movieAiTranslateSummaryNoop: The synopsis is already in the interface language
detailPanel.movieAiTranslateNoop: The title is already in the interface language
detailPanel.movieAiUnconfigured: AI provider is not configured. Open Settings → Experimental features.
detailPanel.movieAiPreviewDesc: Nothing is written until you apply. Scraped title and synopsis stay untouched.
detailPanel.refreshMetadataConfirmDesc: Refresh details for “{title}”. This may take a while. Continue?
detailPanel.revealInFileManagerMockHint: Requires Web API (VITE_USE_WEB_API) and the local backend to open the file manager
detailPanel.revealInFileManagerNoPath: This title has no file path on record
detailPanel.inTrashBanner: This title is in trash. Restore it to the library, or delete permanently from trash (will try to remove video files and scrape cache).
detailPanel.ratingLockedInTrash: Rating cannot be changed while the title is in trash.
detailPanel.moveToTrashConfirm: The title will disappear from the library list and move to trash. Files are not removed until you delete permanently from trash.
detailPanel.deleteMoviePermanentlyConfirm: Removes the database record and tries to delete the video, scrape cache, and movie.nfo. This cannot be undone.
detailPanel.deleteMovieConfirm: Removes this title from the library (cast, tags, media links). The system tries to delete the main video, scraped files, and movie.nfo in the same folder. If files are busy or paths fail, clean up manually later.

aiSettings.title: AI
aiSettings.confirmationHint: Policy changes save automatically and stop replies being generated. With read-only mode off, each data change still requires preview and confirmation.
aiSettings.autoSaveFailed: Autosave failed; changes have not taken effect: {message}
aiSettings.invalidLimits: Enter whole numbers within the allowed ranges. Valid changes save automatically.
aiSettings.privacyHint: Standard mode hides file paths in remote model tool results. Minimal text also hides titles, summaries and notes in tool results. Your messages, conversation context and text explicitly sent for translation or polishing still reach the configured model.
aiSettings.stepLimitHint: No limit by default. Enable to set a limit of 1–30 calls.
aiSettings.writeLimit: Confirmations per minute across all clients (1–60)
aiSettings.retentionHint: Expired statistics, audit entries and standalone action receipts are removed when records are read or created. Chat text and linked receipts remain until the session is deleted. Cleanup does not undo library changes.
aiSettings.providerHint: Use an OpenAI-compatible service. The key is stored in local library configuration. Connection tests send a real request and may incur charges.
aiSettings.mockHint: Mock mode has no real model calls and does not invent usage statistics.
aiSettings.coverage: Calls reporting usage / all model calls
aiSettings.usageHint: Only provider-reported usage is counted. Missing usage is unknown; incomplete coverage is marked partially known. Non-streaming actions have no first-text timing. Usage is not cost; billing is determined by your provider.
aiSettings.auditHint: Includes reads, previews, confirmations and denials. The failed filter shows errors and denials; other outcome filters apply only to requests. Raw arguments and text are not displayed here.
aiSettings.moved: AI configuration and governance have moved to AI settings. The former experimental switch no longer controls the backend. Explicitly enable AI in the new section.
